explanation: Chapter, Index, Preface, and Glossary are all sections or structural components found within a book. A bookmark is an external item used with a book but is not part of its inherent content or structure.
Hades, Persephone, Charon, and Cerberus are all directly associated with and reside in the Greek Underworld. Zeus, while an Olympian god, rules the sky and Mount Olympus, not the Underworld.
Meter, Liter, Gram, and Celsius are all standard units of measurement within the metric system. Foot is a unit of length in the imperial and U.S. customary systems, making it the odd one out.
